name: soul.Saga
source:
ACT FAST!! QUICK N' EASY WAY2HEAVEN : 
All Rize Nirvan had to do was play the Hero-

...Memorize her Central Heavenly Command-given lines, and bring 1000 stories to a close for a chance to ascend to real Paradise. 

And everything always goes according to the script... until the Villain, "Emblem of Wickedness, Devourer of Seas*, Witch King of Darkness" Belthyme von Bonjangles falls in love... with her?!?!?

*only a rumor

[From [url=https://doubleseraph.itch.io/souldotsaga]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
速來！！又快又輕鬆，上天堂的捷徑：
萊茲．涅爾凡只要演好英雄就行了——

……背熟天界中央司令部發給她的臺詞，為1000個故事畫上句號，就有機會升上真正的樂園。

一切總是照著劇本走……直到反派「邪惡的象徵、諸海的吞噬者*、黑暗巫王」貝爾泰姆．馮．邦詹格爾斯墜入愛河……愛上的居然是她？！？！

*僅為傳聞
